records.name: Storm Sentry
records.reviewScope: Identity, entry gate, skill list, progression and shared-resource dependencies; proficiency statement and full automation remain unverified.

prerequisites.feat: Least Dragonmark (Mark of Storm: gust of wind)

records.dependencySummary: Dragonmark powers fund the granted actions. Class levels increase gust uses and selected wind DCs; mark caster-level stacking is capped at five effective heir levels. Shield duration, bull-rush strength, and weapon charge effects depend on the expended mark tier. Weapon charges expire with duration or loss of possession.
gaps: Shared dragonmark expenditure, mark-tier-dependent effects, capped caster-level stacking, and temporary weapon state require integration. No independent daily pools may be invented for these actions.
records.nextAction: Integrate the shared dragonmark subsystem, then add exact-source unlock, spending, expiry, multiclass and removal regressions.
records.excludedDiscovery: The Pathfinder conversion returned by search has different entry requirements and a ten-level table; it was not used as 3.5 evidence.
